thinking_adapt.label: Adapt
thinking_adapt.description: When selected, a run summary including raw tool output is sent to an external decision service configured on this machine, such as OpenCode Zen or Alibaba Cloud Model Studio.
thinking_adapt.upgrade_required: This daemon is too old for Adapt. Upgrade the daemon to enable it.

daemon.cli_install_windows_help: Windows has no script installer. Ask your workspace administrator, or download the multica-cli-<version>-windows-<arch>.zip archive for the release you want from the internal release source ({{downloadsUrl}}/cli/v<version>/ — the current version is in {{latestManifestUrl}}) and extract multica.exe onto your PATH.
daemon.workspaces_root_env_managed: Pinned by the MULTICA_WORKSPACES_ROOT environment variable — change it there instead.
daemon.workspaces_root_risk_gc: The daemon's garbage collector periodically deletes expired task directories and build artifacts under this root. Choose a dedicated, empty folder (e.g. D:\multica_workspaces) — never a drive root, your Desktop, or a folder holding personal projects or important files.
daemon.workspaces_root_risk_no_migration: The change applies to new runs only: existing task working directories (workdir) and the shared Git repository cache (.repos) under the old path are not migrated. Clean up the old path yourself; unfinished runs re-check-out their repositories under the new path.
daemon.workspaces_root_risk_restart: The daemon restarts immediately after you choose a folder, and the new path takes effect on restart.
daemon.workspaces_root_risk_restart_active_one: The daemon restarts immediately after you choose a folder, interrupting the {{count}} run currently active on this device.
daemon.workspaces_root_risk_restart_active_othe: The daemon restarts immediately after you choose a folder, interrupting the {{count}} runs currently active on this device.
daemon.workspaces_root_reset_risk_no_migration: The reset applies to new runs only: existing task working directories (workdir) and the shared Git repository cache (.repos) under the current path are not migrated. Clean up that path yourself; unfinished runs re-check-out their repositories under the default path.
daemon.workspaces_root_reset_risk_restart: The daemon restarts immediately after you confirm, and the default path takes effect on restart.
daemon.workspaces_root_reset_risk_restart_activ: The daemon restarts immediately after you confirm, interrupting the {{count}} run currently active on this device.

github.toast_account_not_reusable: {{login}} is no longer available to reuse. It may have just been disconnected elsewhere or uninstalled on GitHub.
github.toast_account_suspended: The installation on {{login}} is suspended on GitHub. Unsuspend it there, then try again.

repositories.github_error_not_authorized: This GitHub account is already connected to a workspace where you are not an owner or admin. Ask an owner or admin of that workspace to connect it here, or to make you an admin there first.
repositories.github_error_unknown_installation: GitHub reports this installation as missing. Reinstall the App on GitHub, then try again.
repositories.github_error_installation_suspended: This installation is suspended on GitHub. Unsuspend it there, then try again. If GitHub stays on the App's settings page instead of returning here, uninstall the App on GitHub and install it again.
repositories.github_error_verification_unavailable: GitHub could not verify this installation right now, so it was not connected. Try connecting again later. If GitHub stays on the App's settings page instead of returning here, uninstall the App on GitHub and install it again.

local.multiple_skills: This selection contains multiple skills. Pick a folder or archive with a single skill, or use "Import package" on the skills page with a GitHub or skills.sh repository URL.
